reviewKind: Static source comparison; not a claim of old-Wasm execution.
ordinaryUnregisteredBareAdmission: Pre-existing: generated pool validation rejects with NoUnsignedValidator while generated pre_dispatch defaults to Ok for calls without a registered ValidateUnsigned pallet. The bare CheckedExtrinsic branch then executes with None origin; a BadOrigin dispatch error is an admitted extrinsic if extensions allow it.
evidence: The generated ValidateUnsigned implementation is identical except for an added allow(deprecated) attribute. Its unregistered pre_dispatch fallback remains Ok, while pool validation remains NoUnsignedValidator.
Both CheckedExtrinsic bare validation and application branches are identical after renaming Extension to ExtensionV0.
SkipCheckIfFeeless source is byte-identical between releases. It supplies no bare callback overrides, so default bare callbacks accept and do not call the wrapped signed-payment implementation.

CheckSpecVersion, CheckTxVersion, CheckGenesis, CheckMortality and CheckNonce source files are byte-identical. CheckWeight extracts its existing arithmetic into a helper, with unchanged weight calculation.

The prior local runtime explicitly registered ImOnline ValidateUnsigned. Old ImOnline pre_dispatch used the trait default to re-run heartbeat signature/session validation and its dispatch accepted None. New ImOnline removes that registration and accepts Authorized origins. The retired bare heartbeat therefore newly fell into the existing unregistered-call fallback until the narrow outer adapter guard rejected it.
scopeDecision: Retain the exact ImOnline heartbeat bare guard. No demonstrated new ordinary-call admission regression warrants widening policy in this SDK migration.
